svg.text: Air-handler shield rev A: where each part goes
Component side, DIGITAL header at the top. Colour = assembly step. Dot = pad 1 (cathode, C1 +, chip pin 1).
U2 fitted, R15 empty, JP1 open.
Rollback to the bus on D2:
U2 off, R15 fitted, JP1 bridged.
TB1, top to bottom: R, C, Y2, W2.
Dashed box at left: the R4's USB-C
under U1. Clip U1's pins to 1.5 mm.
